title: Tensor product of pro-étale sheaves
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category with a closed symmetric monoidal
structure $(\otimes,\mathbf 1)$. Examples are $\mathcal A=\Mod_R$ for a commutative
ring $R$, and $\mathcal A=\Ab$ with the tensor product $M\otimes N=M\otimes_{\mathbf Z}N$,
unit $\mathbf Z$ and internal hom the group $\Hom(M,N)$. For $\Ab$ this is the monoidal
structure used throughout, *not* the cartesian one.

Let $C$ be a site whose underlying category is essentially small, relative to the size of
the morphism groups of $\mathcal A$. Examples are the small pro-étale site
$X_{\mathrm{proét}}$ of a scheme $X$ ([def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]) and the category of
profinite sets with the coherent topology. Write $\Sh(C,\mathcal A)$ for the category of
$\mathcal A$-valued sheaves on $C$ and $a$ for sheafification.

The *tensor product* of $\mathcal F,\mathcal G\in\Sh(C,\mathcal A)$ is the sheafification
of the objectwise tensor product,

$$
\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal G:=a\bigl(U\longmapsto\mathcal F(U)\otimes\mathcal G(U)\bigr),
$$

with unit the sheafified constant presheaf $a(\underline{\mathbf 1})$. Then:

1. this is a symmetric monoidal structure on $\Sh(C,\mathcal A)$, and sheafification from
   $\mathcal A$-valued presheaves with the objectwise tensor product is a strong symmetric
   monoidal functor;
2. the structure is closed: every functor $\mathcal F\otimes-$ has a right adjoint
   $\mathcal{H}om(\mathcal F,-)$. Hence $\mathcal F\otimes-$ and $-\otimes\mathcal F$
   preserve colimits, and in particular they are right exact.

For $\mathcal A=\Ab$, the tensor product of abelian sheaves is the sheafified objectwise
$\otimes_{\mathbf Z}$, with unit the constant sheaf $\underline{\mathbf Z}$.

proof.text: Closed coefficient tensorLeft is a left adjoint, so it preserves finite colimits. Apply Mathlib rightExactFunctor_le_additiveFunctor (lem-sfb-preserving-colimits-additive). Transport additivity to tensorRight through BraidedCategory.tensorLeftIsoTensorRight. The four MonoidalPreadditive axioms are the resulting functors map_zero and map_add identities.

Replace C by equivSmallModel C in the coefficient Hom universe. On the induced small site, apply the existing project theorem GrothendieckTopology.hasSheafify_of_isGrothendieckAbelian. Transport HasSheafify back by hasSheafifyEssentiallySmallSite and extract HasWeakSheafify. This discharges sheafification existence without an extra hypothesis.

Use exactly sfbSheafTensorStructure J for the symmetric tensor and its strong monoidal sheafification. The existing comparison tensors inverse sheafification counits and composes with Functor.Monoidal.muIso, giving the sheafified objectwise tensor. Its tensor unit is definitionally constantSheaf J A applied to the coefficient tensor unit. The structure dependency carries the localization, tensor-stability and coherence portion of the unit route.

Install both enriched-Hom existence families from presheaf_enrichedHoms_exist, giving the canonical pointwise presheaf MonoidalClosed structure. Install the monoidal and symmetric structures from sfbSheafTensorStructure, and its strong monoidal reflector. Apply Mathlib Monoidal.Reflective.monoidalClosed to sheafificationAdjunction: this is exactly Day reflection from the units Closedness paragraph. No separate sfbSheafTensorClosed package is required.

The resulting tensorLeft functors are left adjoints, hence preserve colimits of every diagram size and finite colimits. Transport these properties to tensorRight using BraidedCategory.tensorLeftIsoTensorRight and preservesColimits_of_natIso / preservesFiniteColimits_of_natIso. Assemble these conclusions with the definitional unit equality. Specializing the supplied coefficient tensor to Ab gives the tensor over the integers and its constant integer unit.
